title: Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic
prompt:
Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic close-up selfie portrait of a beautiful young adult woman in her early twenties, approximately 20 years old, with an East Asian appearance, seated indoors in a softly illuminated modern bedroom or apartment. Capture an intimate, feminine, naturally glamorous social-media selfie aesthetic. Use a vertical composition, framing her from the top of her head to her lower torso, with her face and upper body occupying most of the image.

She has a delicate heart-shaped oval face, softly rounded cheeks, a small tapered chin, a petite straight nose, and naturally full, softly defined rosy-pink lips. Her smooth, luminous porcelain-fair skin features subtle peach undertones, realistic fine texture, gentle cheek blush, and delicate highlights across her forehead, nose, shoulders, and collarbones. Her large, expressive dark brown eyes feature subtle gray-brown contact lenses, softly defined eyeliner, long curled eyelashes, and naturally shaped eyebrows. A tiny beauty mark appears beneath one eye. She gazes directly into the camera with a calm, slightly shy, alluring expression, her lips gently closed and her head tilted subtly downward.

Her silky medium ash-brown hair is styled in a sleek, shoulder-length bob with softly inward-curving ends, delicate layered strands, and airy straight bangs falling just above her eyebrows. A few strands frame her face and partially sweep across one cheek.

Her physique is slender yet naturally curvaceous, with narrow shoulders, a defined waist, and a prominently full bust. She wears a delicate pastel floral off-the-shoulder dress featuring pale buttery yellow, powder blue, ivory, and muted sage-green watercolor botanical patterns. The dress has a ruched, softly gathered bodice, short off-shoulder puff sleeves with elastic ruffled edges, narrow shoulder straps, and a dramatically low-cut sweetheart neckline. Two gathered fabric panels form the structured bust area, connected by a tiny horizontal gold-tone metal bar at the center, leaving a pronounced central cutout beneath the neckline. The fabric fits closely around her torso, emphasizing its soft pleats and natural contours. Preserve the precise revealing garment construction without adding any extra clothing.

Her shoulders face the camera, her torso leans slightly forward, and one arm extends toward the camera as though holding a smartphone. The background features warm cream-colored walls, a partially open white door, a small wall switch, and subtle everyday room details, softly out of focus.

Use diffused warm indoor daylight, gentle shadows, natural skin luminosity, realistic hair strands, detailed fabric texture, and subtle smartphone-camera perspective. Simulate a 28mm equivalent lens, shallow depth of field, understated cinematic color grading, soft highlights, warm ivory tones, delicate pastel colors, natural proportions, and exceptionally realistic photographic detail. Aspect ratio 9:16.
